tips.label: because＋子句
tips.text: because 後接主詞＋動詞，說明原因。

tips.label: because of＋名詞
tips.text: because of 後接名詞或名詞片語，不能直接接完整子句。

tips.label: 逗號補充說明
tips.text: 非限定關係子句補充已明確的人或事物；用逗號隔開，不能用 that，也不能省略關係代名詞。

tips.label: 選關係代名詞
tips.text: 人作主詞用 who；人作受詞正式用 whom；物或動物用 which。

notes.title: because 與 because of
notes.description: 兩者都表示「因為」。判斷空格後是否有主詞與動詞：完整子句用 because，名詞片語用 because of。because of 也可接名詞性 V-ing 片語，但本課練習以名詞片語為主。
examples: We stayed home because it rained.（我們因為下雨待在家。）
We stayed home because of the rain.（我們因為下雨待在家。）

notes.title: 原因放在句首或句尾
notes.rule: Because + S + V, S + V.；Because of + N, S + V.
notes.description: 原因放在句首時，通常用逗號與主要子句隔開；放在句尾時通常不加逗號。標準英語中，不要把 because 和 so 同時用來連接同一組原因與結果。
examples: Because it rained, we canceled the activity.（因為下雨，我們取消了活動。）
Because of the rain, we canceled the activity.（因為下雨，我們取消了活動。）

notes.title: 非限定關係子句
notes.description: 用來補充說明已經明確的先行詞。插在句中時前後用逗號隔開，放在句尾時前面加逗號。刪去補充子句後，主要句子仍然完整。關係代名詞不能省略，也不能換成 that。
examples: Amy, who is my friend, helps people in need.（艾咪是我的朋友，她會幫助有需要的人。）
I bought this carrot, which looks odd.（我買了這根胡蘿蔔，它的外觀很奇怪。）

notes.title: 人用 who 或 whom
notes.description: 看關係代名詞在子句裡的角色：執行動作用 who；接受動作，正式用法用 whom。受格在一般英語也常用 who，因此題目不將受格 who 和 whom 同時列為競爭答案。介系詞放在關係代名詞前時，正式用法採 whom。
examples: Ben, who helps us, works here.（班會幫助我們，他在這裡工作。）
Mr. Lin, whom we met yesterday, is a teacher.（林先生是老師，我們昨天見過他。）
Anna, to whom I spoke, was kind.（安娜是我交談的對象，她很親切。）

notes.title: 物或動物用 which
notes.description: which 可以在關係子句中作主詞或受詞。非限定用法即使作受詞也不能省略。不要重複加上代替先行詞的 it 或 they。
examples: This apple, which looks odd, is sweet.（這顆蘋果外觀奇怪，但很甜。）
This photo, which I treasure, is old.（這張我珍惜的照片很舊了。）

notes.title: 限定與非限定的差別
notes.description: 限定用法沒有逗號，用來指出是哪一個人或事物；非限定用法有逗號，只補充已明確的對象。單字 issue 的例句使用限定關係子句，其餘文法題以本課非限定用法為主。單字與片語例句為 AI 補寫，中譯亦為補寫；grocery 在「食品雜貨」的用法常用複數 groceries。
examples: The woman who is listening to music is an actress.（正在聽音樂的那位女子是女演員。）
The woman, who is listening to music, is an actress.（那位女子是女演員，她正在聽音樂。）

quiz.question: We bought groceries ___ the fridge was empty.
quiz.hint: the fridge was empty 有主詞與動詞，是完整子句，前面用 because。

quiz.question: The activity was canceled ___ the heavy rain.
quiz.hint: the heavy rain 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: I treasure this bag ___ my mom made it.
quiz.hint: my mom made it 是完整子句，要用 because 連接原因。

quiz.question: The potato looks odd ___ its shape.
quiz.hint: its shape 是名詞片語，不是完整子句，因此用 because of。

quiz.question: ___ Ben was busy, he could not assist us.
quiz.hint: Ben was busy 含主詞與動詞，句首用 Because，原因子句後以逗號隔開。

quiz.question: The farmers lost money ___ the bad weather.
quiz.hint: the bad weather 是名詞片語，表示原因時用 because of。

quiz.question: We support Amy ___ she helps people in need.
quiz.hint: she helps people in need 是完整子句，前面要用 because。

quiz.question: We eventually found a solution ___ your advice.
quiz.hint: your advice 是名詞片語，前面用 because of；advice 不可數。

quiz.question: Please turn on the fan ___ the room is hot.
quiz.hint: the room is hot 是完整子句，表示原因時用 because。

quiz.question: Life became tough ___ the lack of food.
quiz.hint: the lack of food 是名詞片語，需接在 because of 後面。

quiz.question: They invest in this farm ___ it grows good food.
quiz.hint: it grows good food 有主詞 it 與動詞 grows，需用 because。

quiz.question: The celebrity could not come ___ a high fever.
quiz.hint: a high fever 是名詞片語，前面用 because of。

quiz.question: We did not throw away the bread ___ it was fresh.
quiz.hint: it was fresh 是完整子句，不能直接接在 because of 後面。

quiz.question: ___ the strong wind, we stayed inside.
quiz.hint: the strong wind 是名詞片語，句首應用 Because of。

quiz.question: I believe in May ___ she always tells the truth.
quiz.hint: she always tells the truth 有主詞與動詞，表示原因要用 because。

quiz.question: We could distribute more food ___ their support.
quiz.hint: their support 是名詞片語，原因介系詞片語用 because of。

quiz.question: The soup tastes weird ___ I added too much salt.
quiz.hint: I added too much salt 是完整子句，用 because 引出原因。

quiz.question: The children smiled ___ the good news.
quiz.hint: the good news 是名詞片語，因此應用 because of。

quiz.question: We educate children about food waste ___ it is an important issue.
quiz.hint: it is an important issue 是完整子句，需用 because。

quiz.question: The food stayed fresh ___ the low temperature.
quiz.hint: the low temperature 是名詞片語，前面需用 because of。

quiz.question: We make use of these boxes because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後需接完整子句，只有 they are strong 具有完整的主詞與動詞結構。

quiz.question: The activity ended early because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語；the rain 符合，其他選項都是完整子句。

quiz.question: Tom is not worried at all because ___.
options: D. his friends can assist him
quiz.hint: because 後面要有完整子句，his friends can assist him 有主詞與動詞。

quiz.question: We eventually reached the farm because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語，the driver's help 表示司機的幫助。

quiz.question: Amy, ___ found a solution, is in my class.
quiz.hint: 先行詞 Amy 是人，空格作 found 的主詞，用 who；非限定子句不能用 that。

quiz.question: This carrot, ___ looks weird, is still fresh.
quiz.hint: 先行詞是物 carrot，用 which；逗號隔開的非限定子句不能用 that。

quiz.question: Mr. Lin, to ___ we turned for advice, was very kind.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 to 後面指人的受格關係代名詞用 whom；whose 表所有格，不適用。

quiz.question: Ben, ___ will assist us, works at the store.
quiz.hint: Ben 是人，空格是 will assist 的主詞，需用 who。

quiz.question: The rain, ___ stopped our activity, finally ended.
quiz.hint: rain 是事物，非限定子句以 which 作主詞；不能用 that。

quiz.question: Ms. Wang, with ___ we discussed the issue, teaches English.
quiz.hint: with 後面需要指人的受格關係代名詞 whom，表示我們和王老師討論議題。

quiz.question: My sister, ___ supports the plan, will join us.
quiz.hint: my sister 指人，空格作 supports 的主詞，用 who；whom 是受格。

quiz.question: This photo, ___ I treasure, is ten years old.
quiz.hint: photo 是物，空格作 treasure 的受詞；非限定用法須保留 which，不能用 that。

quiz.question: Jack, for ___ we saved some food, arrived late.
quiz.hint: for 後指人的受格關係代名詞用 whom，表示我們替 Jack 留了食物。

quiz.question: The celebrity, ___ lives nearby, came to our activity.
quiz.hint: celebrity 是人，關係代名詞作 lives 的主詞，所以用 who。

quiz.question: Our fridge, ___ prevents food from going bad, is new.
quiz.hint: fridge 是物，空格作 prevents 的主詞，非限定用法選 which。

quiz.question: Peter, from ___ I learned this lesson, hates food waste.
quiz.hint: from 後指人 Peter，要用受格 whom；from whom 表示從他那裡。

quiz.question: My dad, ___ invests in farms, loves fresh food.
quiz.hint: my dad 是人，空格作 invests 的主詞，要用 who。

quiz.question: These boxes, ___ we make use of, are very strong.
quiz.hint: boxes 是物，空格是 make use of 的受詞；逗號後用 which，不能用 that。

quiz.question: Anna, ___ we met at the activity, is a nurse.
quiz.hint: Anna 是人，空格作 met 的受詞，這些選項中用 whom；日常英語也可用 who，但非限定用法不能用 that。

quiz.question: Our teacher, ___ educates us about food waste, is kind.
quiz.hint: teacher 是人，關係代名詞作 educates 的主詞，用 who。

quiz.question: The bus, ___ eventually arrived, was full.
quiz.hint: bus 是物，空格作 arrived 的主詞，要用 which，非限定用法不能用 that。

quiz.question: David, about ___ we talked yesterday, needs support.
quiz.hint: about 後面指人的受格關係代名詞用 whom，表示昨天談到的人是 David。

quiz.question: My grandma, ___ never throws away fresh food, is wise.
quiz.hint: grandma 是人，空格作 throws 的主詞，須用 who。

quiz.question: This farm, ___ grows odd carrots, is near our school.
quiz.hint: farm 是物，空格作 grows 的主詞，用 which；此處不是表地點的副詞。

quiz.question: Lisa, ___ the students thanked, helped distribute food.
quiz.hint: Lisa 是人，空格作 thanked 的受詞，這些選項中用 whom；非限定關係代名詞不能省略。

quiz.question: Kevin, ___ believes in me, is my best friend.
quiz.hint: Kevin 是人，空格作 believes 的主詞，用主格 who。

quiz.question: The soup, ___ tastes a little odd, is still warm.
quiz.hint: soup 是物，空格作 tastes 的主詞，非限定子句用 which。

quiz.question: Mr. Chen, to ___ I gave the groceries, thanked me.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 to 後指人要用 whom，表示我把食品雜貨交給陳先生。

quiz.question: My brother, ___ is not hungry at all, skipped lunch.
quiz.hint: my brother 指人，空格作 is 的主詞，用 who，不能用受格 whom。

quiz.question: The plan, ___ helps people in need, has our support.
quiz.hint: plan 是事物，空格作 helps 的主詞，用 which；逗號隔開的非限定子句不能用 that。
